Your profile:

 * Good English skills are required.

At ENPULSION, you'll join a young, international team united by a deep passion for space technology and innovation. Ready to leave your mark on a market? 

The France and Benelux market is still wide open - we're looking for someone who wants a say in how it's built, not just someone to execute someone else's playbook. If you want real ownership and a direct line to the people making decisions, keep reading.

You'll own the France & Benelux partner ecosystem from day one, while also managing leads and accounts for selected opportunities in DACH - with room to expand into additional markets as the business grows.

What you'll do

 * Grow and develop the partner network - distributors, resellers, system integrators - across France and Benelux: recruit new partners, and take the existing ones to the next level through account management and joint go-to-market planning.

 * Create your own pipeline - develop relationships with partners and end customers directly, routing opportunities through the right partners.

 * Real ownership of a market that's still mostly untapped - a few partners exist, but the network is yours to build and develop.

 * Direct access and visibility, including regular contact with our CEO.

 * A path to more markets, more influence, and more responsibility as you grow - where you take this in two years is largely up to you.

 * Benefits like extra days off, Wiener Linien Ticket and regular team events.

 * Annual salary: EUR 60,000-83,000 gross OTE.

What you bring

 * Several years of experience in sales, channel development, business development, or account management.

 * A proactive, hunter mindset - you create opportunities, you don't wait for them.

 * Strong communication skills; comfortable picking up the phone and engaging stakeholders at every level, from technical teams to senior leadership and C-suite, and building relationships with distributors, integrators, and end customers.

 * Self-organized and independent - you set your own priorities and drive your own schedule.

 * German: minimum C1 · French: minimum C1 · English: professional working proficiency.

Nice to have: experience in IT, networking, infrastructure, or data centers; familiarity with distributors/VARs/system integrators; CRM experience (HubSpot a plus).

As an attractive employer, Erste Group offers interesting career opportunities in an international environment.

Within Group Risk Management, the Market & Liquidity Risk Analytics team is responsible for the calculation, monitoring and further development of market and liquidity risk measures across Erste Group. The team ensures the reliable processing of risk data and provides key inputs for risk management, reporting and regulatory requirements. 1 Liquidity and Market Risk Specialist (all genders)  * Location:Wien

 * Working hours:Full-time

 * Occupational Area:Risikomanagement

 * Company:Erste Group Bank AG

Your Tasks

 * Operate and monitor daily market risk processes covering PnL, risk measurement and market data management

 * Produce and validate risk metrics used for Independent Price Verification (IPV), internal risk steering and regulatory purposes

 * Ensure the quality and consistency of market data across pricing and risk management platforms

 * Analyze, reconcile and resolve data and valuation issues in cooperation with Risk, Finance and IT teams

 * Support the enhancement of market and liquidity risk analytics and reporting capabilities

Your Background

 * University degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Economics, IT or a related quantitative field

 * First exposure to valuation principles and reporting standards for capital market products

 * Interest in developing your expertise in Market and Liquidity Risk Management

 * Strong communication skills, a reliable working style and fluent English; German or another CEE language is an advantage

 * Solid IT and data management skills, including Python and/or SQL

Our Offer

 * A diverse role at the intersection of risk management, data and financial markets

 * The opportunity to gain hands-on experience with market and liquidity risk methodologies in an international banking environment

 * A collaborative team with plenty of opportunities to learn and develop professionally

 * Flexible working arrangements with a combination of office and home office

 * For this position, we offer a gross annual salary starting at EUR 52,200.00 (full-time, including overtime allowance). Your actual salary will be based on your qualifications, experience, and individual fit for the role.

 * Discover and enjoy the https://www.erstegroup.com/en/career/benefits of Erste Group

 * We consider the diversity of our employees as key to innovation and success. As employer we are proud to offer everyone equal chances, irrespective of age, skin colour, religious belief, gender, sexual orientation or origin.

Interested? 

Join our Market & Liquidity Risk Analytics team and contribute to the reliable measurement and management of risk across Erste Group. #believeinyourself

At a glance

 * Starting date: as soon as possible

 * Working hours: 20-25 h/week

 * Location: 1030 Vienna

 

Your role with us on the team

 

 * Support the development of automation scripts and small internal tools (e.g. Python-based solutions)

 * Assist in data preparation, transformation, and analysis

 * Contribute to data pipelines and data flows using modern platforms (e.g. Databricks)

 * Help build and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports for risk purposes

 * Leverage AI/LLM tools to improve efficiency (e.g. automation, documentation, data analysis)

 * Collaborate with team members on small automation and data use cases

 * Gain hands-on experience with modern data platforms and tools

 

Your core competencies

 

 * Ongoing studies in IT, Computer Science, Data Science or a related technical field

 * Fluency in English

 * Strong interest in data, automation and modern technologies

 * Basic programming skills (preferably Python)

 * Basic understanding of data handling and structured datasets (SQL is a plus)

 * Interest in risk related methods especially Non-Financial Risk

 * Analytical thinking and structured working style

 * First experience with Power BI, Databricks, APIs, low-code tools or Git is a plus

 

What's in it for you

 

 * Work & Study: The ability to gain practical experience with real world data and automation use cases in an international banking environment while continuing your studies

 * Flexibility: Working hours adaptable to your university schedule and a balance of on-site and home-office days

 * Onboarding: An easy start with a buddy from your team to guide you

 * Community: Internal networking with other students

 * Internationality: Operations in Central and Eastern Europe with English as the corporate language, providing a foundation for an international career

 * Canteen: A wide variety of healthy, tasty, and heavily subsidized meal options

 * Compensation: An attractive monthly student salary of gross EUR 2,619.73 (based on 38.5 hours per week)

jobs.occupation: Senior Consultant (Mid-Level) - Focus Product Management (m/f/d) / Product Owner
jobs.description:
1 Senior Consultant (Mid-Level) - Focus Product Management (m/f/d) / Product Owner Tasks
As a Senior Consultant focused on product management at Trinsik, you own digital products end-to-end - from blank page to live, growing product. In our venture-building teams, you turn client and user needs into a clear product vision, validate fast, and lead cross-functional teams to ship.

What You'll Do
 * Define the vision, strategy and roadmap for new digital products, aligned with client business goals and validated against real user needs
 * Take products from scratch - frame the problem, shape the proposition, and validate before scaling; create new propositions, not just improve existing ones
 * Lead product discovery with user research, analytics, benchmarking and hypothesis validation; size opportunities quantitatively
 * Prioritize the backlog by customer value, business impact and technical feasibility, using clear frameworks
 * Lead agile teams across engineering, UX/UI, data and QA, coordinating with marketing, sales and operations for launch
 * Define success metrics, track them, and run an evidence-based cycle of experimentation, learning and iteration
 * Use generative AI and agents to accelerate definition, validation and prototyping - AI as part of how you work
 * Contribute to commercial outcomes - help ship revenue-generating propositions and deliver against targets

Requirements
 * Hands-on experience across the full digital product lifecycle - discovery, definition, delivery and measurement
 * Exposure to 0-to-1 work: you've helped create and validate new products or features, not only maintained existing roadmaps
 * 3-5 years in product management / product ownership for digital products
 * Commercially minded - you've worked to clear targets and are keen to own a number
 * Data-literate: fluent with product analytics, A/B testing and funnel/CRO optimization; you use data as evidence
 * A clear writer - your documents move discussions forward and help teams decide
 * High agency and comfort with ambiguity: you set your own priorities and move without waiting for a perfect brief
 * Strong stakeholder management with senior stakeholders and clients, written and verbal, in German and English
 * A growth mindset: curious, self-driven, and comfortable being challenged

Nice to have
 * Experience in venture building, startups, or innovation consulting
 * Technical fluency to dialogue with engineering (APIs, web/mobile architectures)
 * Product marketing or positioning background
 * Solid command of agile methods (Scrum, Kanban) and prioritization frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW, ...)

Benefits
The Numbers: €60,000 - €70,000 gross annually (positioned according to your competencies)

Daily Perk: your choice: a public transport subsidy or a tax-free daily lunch allowance.

Permanent discounts with 600+ top brands via our Corporate Benefits platform.

Flexibility & Trust: Flexible hours and home office to balance life while keeping a vibrant team dynamic.

Change of Scenery: Work remotely from anywhere in the EU, up to 20 calendar days/year, or use sabbatical options.

Exciting Playground: Dive into different industries, apps and digital solutions with plenty of creative freedom.

Latest Software: We work with what's current. If you know something newer and better, let's test it.

International Team: An experienced crew in Austria, Germany, Hungary and Switzerland.

Flat Hierarchies: Your input finds open ears - from designs to business ideas or party plans.

Feedback Culture: open, and direct.

Cool Workplace: Collaboration happens right in the middle of Vienna.

Application process
We run a 3-stage process to understand who you are - and help you understand us. We position the role based on competencies, not titles.
